name: Constellation Energy Corporation
business_summary: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. Following the January 2026 Calpine acquisition, the combined company controls roughly 55 GW of generating capacity (~22 GW nuclear) plus Calpine's competitive retail electricity platform. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
